item.title: Fat guy wins Shitty Singer Competition
item.desc: When he's not trolling for snacks, Hank Johanson can sing. And he proved it by winning the Shitty Singer Competition yesterday. Producers of the hit talent contest show promise to run the premise into the ground, one botched out-of-key power ballad at a time.

item.name: story3
item.title: Paparazzi late to the scene
item.desc: Fashionista Jill Von Crastenburg was forced to reenact a tantrum Tuesday night when the paparazzi arrived late to the club she was partying at. She's checked into a psych ward twice to bolster the ratings of her reality show.

item.desc: What's the haps honey? January Natasha Vasquez bubbled her way though the game show Are You an Idiot Bitch? After losing, the diva disaster said she doesn't mind as she is thrilled about finding out she's had a month named after her.

item.desc: Tearson is a hunk that just won't quit. Hit movies - erratic behavior - he is denying reports of alcohol and drug abuse. And we believe him! What a hunk! He'll be with us forever.

item.desc: Either she's out of nicotine gum or the rumors she's off her meds are true - as sources say moments ago McIntosh was sitting naked in the middle of the freeway tearing out pieces of her hair. We'll have more on this story soon.

item.title: Samantha Muldoon returns baby to Sub-Saharan Africa
item.desc: Here�'s proof that cute babies do not always grow into cute toddlers. Muldoon says she has grown tired of the adopted child's constant crying. She indicated that poor babies are often ungrateful and deserve to go back.

item.name: story9
item.title: Jill Von Crastenberg spotted in a supermarket. 14 pages of photos!!!
item.desc: Nobody is quite sure why she’s so famous but, when a teen heiress buys milk, we send photographers. Jill Von Crastenburg, best known for being a self-absorbed cokehead who hasn’t worn underwear since the late 90s, spent half an hour in a downtown Los Santos supermarket earlier, mostly in the creams and ointments aisle. Has another Vinewood leading man been dining at her STD buffet? Remember: you heard it here first.

item.name: story10
item.title: A wristy business!!!
item.desc: One man. One old gym sock. A sticky situation. Somebody should have told billionaire playboy Alfonso Vasquez that a sex tape is only good publicity when there are at least two people involved. Unless it features a hot girl, of course. Or a MILF. Nobody wants to watch a 50-year-old man sweating in a locked bathroom. Least of all his daughter, we imagine.

item.name: story11
item.title: X and Y don't hit the spot at Jouster's
item.desc: A transgender man from Alderney is suing Jouster's Gentlemen's Club complaining that his membership application has been denied. The club is a blue blood affair where Liberty City's elite mingle with politicians while sitting in saunas or enjoying an afternoon cordialand a cigar. They said in a statement to the press that Jouster's is "a club for gentlemen, not genetic confusions."

item.name: story11
item.title: Parents' Group files complaint about Little Bitchz dolls.
item.desc: A parents group gathered outside the offices of Little Bitchz Inc, maker of the immensely popular doll. Over 50 million of the dolls have sold worldwide under names like Frisky Felicity, Naughty Natasha, and Tessa Tart. A spokesperson said "These dolls teach girls to be little materialistic sluts. What are we teaching these kids on how to act when they get older? No man wants a ditsy girl that wears fishnet stockings and leather who swoons and gives it up for a shiny bauble."
